FEATURE_MATRIX.md.content:
# Feature Matrix

## Public portal
- Home dashboard and quick navigation: implemented
- Multi-field submission metadata: implemented
- Drag-and-drop attachment: implemented
- Extension and 10 MB validation: implemented
- Preview/edit/confirm sequence: implemented
- Live submission with bounded retry and timeout: implemented
- Receipt and print: implemented
- Recent activity: implemented without synthetic records
- Tracking preview/edit/confirm: implemented
- Rich response, aliases and timeline rendering: implemented
- Support submission: implemented
- Settings, themes, endpoint override/reset/export: implemented

## Operations hub
- OTP request and verification: implemented through workflow actions
- No mock/demo authentication: enforced
- Dashboard summary: implemented
- Tasks and activity queue: implemented
- Search, filter, create and update task: implemented
- Inbox and compose: implemented
- Document repository and upload: implemented
- Workflow templates and instances: implemented
- Audit log: implemented
- User administration: implemented
- Operations settings and session clearing: implemented

## Engineering
- Browser-only static runtime: implemented
- `file://` compatibility: implemented subject to browser CORS policy of remote workflow
- Zero third-party runtime dependencies: implemented
- Safe text-node rendering for backend values: implemented
- Responsive mobile layout and accessibility affordances: implemented
- No automatic polling: implemented

README.md.name: README.md
README.md.content:
# NITDA Intelligent Portal — Enhanced Complete Package

## Start
Open `index.html` directly or deploy the folder to any static host. Open `ops.html` for the secured Operations Hub.

## Restored and enhanced capabilities
- Rich public landing page and responsive navigation
- Two-stage submission preview and confirmation
- 10 MB file validation and nine accepted formats
- Production Power Automate submission and tracking endpoints retained
- Submission receipt, print support and recent browser activity
- Rich tracking response with normalized fields and optional timeline
- Structured support workflow
- Persistent Settings tab with production-default restoration and export
- OTP request and verification pathway with no demo bypass
- Operations dashboard; tasks/queue; inbox; documents; workflows; audit; users; settings
- No mock records, fabricated success, CDN, React, Tailwind, npm, Node, TypeScript, Docker or build pipeline

## Endpoint contract
Public actions use the configured submission or tracking endpoint. Operations actions use the configured operations endpoint with an `action` property such as `OTP_REQUEST`, `TASK_LIST`, `DOCUMENT_UPLOAD`, or `AUDIT_LIST`. Backend authorization remains authoritative.

## Files
- `index.html` — public portal
- `ops.html` — secured operations hub
- `assets/portal.css` — shared responsive design system
- `assets/common.js` — shared configuration, transport, validation and helpers
- `FEATURE_MATRIX.md` — implemented capability register
- `manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` — package metadata and integrity
